title: General-Reasoner: Advancing LLM Reasoning Across All Domains
authors_zh: Xueguang Ma、Qian Liu、Dongfu Jiang、Ge Zhang、Zejun MA、Wenhu Chen

title: Problem
问题
html:
Rule-based answer checkers work for math but reject equivalent free-form answers in science and professional domains, blocking broad RL data collection.

General-Reasoner crawls broad questions, normalizes answer types, and uses a context-aware generative verifier to retain questions with scoreable answers. The decision boundary is whether a serialized record survives generative answer verification with chain-of-thought and context plus category and difficulty filters; the direct output is WebInstruct-verified, consumed by multi-domain reasoning RL rather than an evaluation-only benchmark.

L4 facts: primary source arXiv:2505.14652; venue/date arXiv preprint (2025); open data WebInstruct-verified at https://huggingface.co/datasets/TIGER-Lab/WebInstruct-verified; scale 228,736 training and 1,000 test question-answer records; full paper, official README, terms, schema, and one actual record checked on 2026-07-27.

规则验证器适合数学精确答案，却会拒绝科学与专业领域中的等价自由表达，阻碍跨领域强化学习数据收集。

该工作抓取广泛问题，规范答案类型，再用能结合上下文推理的生成式验证器保留可评分问答。 判定边界是记录能否通过“结合上下文与推理的生成式答案验证、类别和难度过滤”并成为跨领域推理强化学习的输入；直接产物是 WebInstruct-verified，不是只用于评测的基准。

L4 事实：主要来源为 arXiv:2505.14652，日期与状态为 2025 年预印本；开放数据为 WebInstruct-verified，规模是228736 条训练问答和 1000 条测试问答；已于 2026-07-27 核验全文、官方说明、条款、字段和一条实际公开记录。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
General-Reasoner crawls broad questions, normalizes answer types, and uses a context-aware generative verifier to retain questions with scoreable answers. Relative to math-centric RL with exact-match verification, it changes the reusable target to id, question, answer, answer type, category, and difficulty and makes generative answer verification with chain-of-thought and context plus category and difficulty filters the feedback boundary, so the central contribution is Track 01 data rather than a model-only, verifier-only, or benchmark-only artifact.

title: Method
方法
html:
Step 1 - Source and normalize the task. Input: web-crawled questions with diverse answer representations. Operation: Normalize prompts, source identifiers, media or tools, references, and expected outputs into candidate records. Output and transition: Auditable candidates advance to target generation. Check / stop rule: Reject a candidate when its task input, source, access terms, or required reference is missing.

Step 2 - Write the reusable target. Input: A normalized candidate and its source evidence. Operation: curation models normalize questions and answers while a generative verifier reasons over equivalence. Output and transition: The resulting answer, rationale, or tool trace is serialized as id, question, answer, answer type, category, and difficulty and advances to verification. Check / stop rule: Stop when the target cannot be linked to its prompt, authoring mechanism, or required environment state.

Step 3 - Verify and package. Input: Generated targets and task-specific correctness metadata. Operation: Apply generative answer verification with chain-of-thought and context plus category and difficulty filters. Output and transition: Passing records form 228,736 training and 1,000 test question-answer records stored as Parquet records and advance to training. Check / stop rule: Reject failed checks; final-answer agreement alone is not treated as proof that every intermediate step is correct.

Step 4 - Train and evaluate the consumer. Input: The pinned dataset revision and the paper's base checkpoint. Operation: Use the records for multi-domain reasoning RL and compare with math-centric RL with exact-match verification. Output and transition: A trained consumer and the paper's controlled evaluation become the final artifacts. Check / stop rule: Pin the data, teacher, tools, prompts, model, seeds, and harness, and do not generalize beyond evaluated domains.

步骤 1：取得并规范任务。输入是带多种答案表达的网页问题。操作是统一题目、来源、媒体或工具、参考信息与预期输出。输出是可审计候选，随后进入目标生成。检查与停止规则是缺少任务输入、来源、使用条款或必要参考时立即拒绝。

步骤 2：写入可复用目标。输入是规范候选及其来源证据。操作是由整理模型规范问题和答案，生成式验证器判断语义等价。输出是按“编号、问题、答案、答案类型、类别和难度”序列化的答案、推理或工具轨迹，随后进入验证。检查与停止规则是目标无法对应题目、生成机制或必要环境状态时停止。

步骤 3：验证并打包。输入是生成目标与任务专用正确性信息。操作是执行结合上下文与推理的生成式答案验证、类别和难度过滤。输出是通过检查的228736 条训练问答和 1000 条测试问答，按官方格式保存并进入训练。检查与停止规则是拒绝失败记录，且不把终答一致当作每个中间步骤都正确的证明。

步骤 4：训练并评估消费方。输入是固定版本的数据与论文基础检查点。操作是用于跨领域推理强化学习，并与使用精确匹配验证的数学专用强化学习比较。输出是训练后模型和受控评测。检查与停止规则是固定数据、教师、工具、提示、模型、随机种子与评测器，结论不越过已评估领域。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Decisive downstream experiment: Across 12 benchmarks including MMLU-Pro, GPQA, SuperGPQA, TheoremQA, BBEH, and MATH AMC, General-Reasoner outperforms the paper's existing RL baselines while preserving math ability. This is evidence for the complete data intervention under the reported training setup, not proof that every released record is correct.

Artifact check: the official release contains 228,736 training and 1,000 test question-answer records and exposes actual fields id, question, answer, answer type, category, and difficulty; on 2026-07-27 its page reported 1192 downloads. Usage is only an impact cross-check, not a causal experiment.

决定性下游实验：在 MMLU-Pro、GPQA、SuperGPQA、TheoremQA、BBEH 和 MATH AMC 等 12 个基准上，General-Reasoner 超过论文所列强化学习基线，同时保持数学能力。 这只能支持论文报告训练设置下的完整数据干预，不能证明每条公开记录都正确。

产物核验：官方发布包含228736 条训练问答和 1000 条测试问答，实际字段是“编号、问题、答案、答案类型、类别和难度”；2026-07-27 数据页显示 1192 次下载。使用量只作影响交叉检查，不是因果实验。

title: Novelty
新意
html: The closest baseline is math-centric RL with exact-match verification. The paper changes the reusable object by making id, question, answer, answer type, category, and difficulty explicit and coupling it to generative answer verification with chain-of-thought and context plus category and difficulty filters. That is a direction signal because another team can train multi-domain reasoning RL from the released records. The inherited backbone, source tasks, autoregressive objective, and public benchmarks are not new.
最近基线是使用精确匹配验证的数学专用强化学习。真正变化是把“编号、问题、答案、答案类型、类别和难度”显式化，并与“结合上下文与推理的生成式答案验证、类别和难度过滤”绑定。另一团队可直接用公开记录训练跨领域推理强化学习，因此它构成数据方向信号。继承的骨干、来源任务、自回归目标和公开基准并不新。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. When a generative verifier can share factual errors with the policy model, the most serious consequence is training on a trace whose apparent correctness does not match its reasoning; reproduce a stratified record-level audit before reuse.
  2. Because web crawling creates provenance, duplication, and contamination risks, downstream gains may not transfer to a new domain or deployment; run source- and domain-specific evaluations rather than relying on the aggregate score.
  3. Reuse must preserve Apache-2.0 and every upstream source or media term; exclude records whose provenance or redistribution right cannot be reconstructed.

1. 如果生成式验证器可能与策略模型共享事实错误，最严重后果是把表面正确但推理不实的轨迹用于训练；复用前应按来源和难度分层抽样复核。
  2. 由于网页抓取带来来源、重复和基准污染风险，汇总收益未必迁移到新领域或部署环境；应分别运行来源级和领域级评测。
  3. 复用必须遵守 Apache-2.0 及全部上游来源或媒体条款；无法重建来源和再分发权利的记录应排除。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
• For teams building multi-domain reasoning RL, pin the official revision, preserve source fields, train a fixed-backbone baseline, and output both a versioned mixture and domain-level metrics. The intervention succeeds only if the target gains survive a provenance and error audit.
  • For auditors, sample records by source and difficulty and replay generative answer verification with chain-of-thought and context plus category and difficulty filters. Produce a keep/reject ledger with failure reasons; do not use the dataset when licenses, task inputs, or verification artifacts are unavailable.

• 构建跨领域推理强化学习的团队应固定官方版本、保留来源字段、训练同骨干基线，并输出带版本的数据混合与分领域指标。只有目标收益通过来源和错误审计后，才算复用成功。
  • 数据审计者应按来源和难度抽样，重放结合上下文与推理的生成式答案验证、类别和难度过滤，输出带失败原因的保留与拒绝台账。许可、任务输入或验证产物缺失时不应使用。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Positioning: General-Reasoner crawls broad questions, normalizes answer types, and uses a context-aware generative verifier to retain questions with scoreable answers.
  • Data object: 228,736 training and 1,000 test question-answer records; each record exposes id, question, answer, answer type, category, and difficulty.
  • Author and selector: curation models normalize questions and answers while a generative verifier reasons over equivalence; retention uses generative answer verification with chain-of-thought and context plus category and difficulty filters.
  • Evidence anchor: Across 12 benchmarks including MMLU-Pro, GPQA, SuperGPQA, TheoremQA, BBEH, and MATH AMC, General-Reasoner outperforms the paper's existing RL baselines while preserving math ability.
  • Reuse decision: suitable for multi-domain reasoning RL; first audit a generative verifier can share factual errors with the policy model and web crawling creates provenance, duplication, and contamination risks.

• 定位：General-Reasoner 从网页整理 22.8 万条跨领域可验证问答，并用生成式验证器处理多种等价答案。
  • 数据对象：228736 条训练问答和 1000 条测试问答，单条记录包含编号、问题、答案、答案类型、类别和难度。
  • 生成与筛选：整理模型规范问题和答案，生成式验证器判断语义等价，并依据结合上下文与推理的生成式答案验证、类别和难度过滤保留。
  • 证据锚点：在 MMLU-Pro、GPQA、SuperGPQA、TheoremQA、BBEH 和 MATH AMC 等 12 个基准上，General-Reasoner 超过论文所列强化学习基线，同时保持数学能力。
  • 复用决定：适合跨领域推理强化学习；先审计生成式验证器可能与策略模型共享事实错误和网页抓取带来来源、重复和基准污染风险。
